newsitem.title: JAPAN: FORECAST-Japan May trade surplus seen surging.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Japan May trade surplus seen surging.

text.p: Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus is expected to have jumped in May, with economists forecasting, on average, a rise of 157 percent from the same period last year.
Forecasts from 12 economists ranged from a surplus of 400 billion yen to 760 billion yen, compared with a surplus of 229 billion yen a year earlier.
The data will be announced at 8.50 a.m. on Wednesday (2350 GMT Tuesday) June 18.
